searchText: looking at adding an initcode limit to EIP-7903 as discussed on ACDE, and it might actually be cleaner to just add a line updating the initcode limit in 7907, rather than rewriting 7903. thoughts? <@360491619402776577> <@552133098075193354> Fine with me yes, that's where we landed i've pushed the update at https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9622 i've marked it as a draft so eth-bot won't automerge and people have an opportunity to review. if there isn't any feedback, i will merge later today or tomorrow.
